messages:
Maeve (AE): FYI - running into pricing friction w/ Apollo (enterprise). They want a single bundled offer: Hosted API + Optimize + Console retention add-on for a 6‑week POC. Asking for a commercial anchor for exec sponsor. Need deal desk + SE input for POC credits vs % discount. Timeline: kickoff in 7 days.
Ravi (SE): quick notes on the POC scope from eng: 6 weeks, 3m active users simulated, ~300 req/s peak, pref model family: 13B fp16. We'll need reserved infra for predictable latency. Recommend POC cap: $8k infra credits + implementation time (SE hours). Can we do credits + temporary 30% bundle discount for production follow-on?
Juniper (Solutions Eng): +1 to Ravi. Also suggest free Console onboarding (1 engineer, 2 weeks) and Optimize tuning included. That makes the initial friction lower. Proposed packaging: 
```
POC offer:
- API credits: $8,000 (consumable)
- Optimize: trial tier (no charge) for POC
- Console: free onboarding + 14d extended retention
Post-POC guidance:
- Optional 3mo commit: 30% off bundle vs standard list
- Cap: 6 months to convert or credits expire
```
Ellen (Deal Desk): Flags: need precise list pricing and target discount band. Standard approval matrix: up to 20% - AE level; 21–35% - Deal Desk mgr; 36–50% - Director. Anything >50% requires CRO sign-off. Is 30% final or negotiable? Also need to capture ARR anchor if they convert.
Maeve (AE): They're asking for a strong anchor to justify internal approval. Target conversion: $250k ARR over 12 months if POC succeeds. Customer asks whether credits can be applied to first invoice and whether Optimize fees can be amortized.
Ellen (Deal Desk): Applying credits to first invoice is OK. Optimize amortization is a finance/legal question — loop in Finance & Legal. For POC I can provisionally approve 30% on the bundle for first 3 months post-conversion if they sign MSA + commit to $200k ARR. Need a one‑pager summary to formalize.
Nora (Legal): Security checklist: Apollo requires SOC2 attestation, data residency in eu-west-1, and a bespoke DPA clause on deletion timelines. Also wants the security questionnaire answers (SQxx) completed before MSA. Who's their legal contact? This blocks finalizing the 30% concession.
Caleb (Finance): From finance: credits applied to first invoice ok, but we need to classify $8k as contra-revenue for the POC unless they convert. For the 30% concession, we need a committed ARR figure and billing cadence to model ACV. If they propose $200k ARR commit, we can accept 30% for first 3 months and phase to list thereafter.
Ravi (SE): infra detail for ops team (saving to thread):
```
POC infra reqs:
- reserved pool: 2x high-mem GPUs (p3 equivalent)
- ephemeral KV cache allowed
- max concurrent sessions: 300
- latency SLO: p95 < 250ms
```
InfraBot (bot): Created POC workspace: workspace-apollo-1902345678, assigned team: se-oncall, infra pool requested.
Maeve (AE): OK I'll draft the one‑pager w/ the numbers and customer legal contact (lex@apollo.com). Can we get the Deal Desk mgr sign-off by EOD tomorrow? Need to share with customer Wed. @Ellen @Caleb @Nora please confirm what you need in the one‑pager.
Ellen (Deal Desk): Need: final list prices, proposed discount %, ARR anchor, MSA/SOW references, renewal terms, and expiration of offer. I'll give mgr sign-off pending those details. :thumbsup:
Nora (Legal): Need: customer legal contact, redline window (we can turn in 72h), data flow diagram placeholder, and security questionnaire answers. If they require EU data residency as a hard requirement we need to note potential latency/cost impact.
Caleb (Finance): Need: billing cadence, revenue recognition note (credits vs SR), and any up-front invoicing. Otherwise finance ok to proceed with provisional terms.
Maeve (AE): Great — drafting now, will circulate in this thread in the next 3 hours. Thanks all. :pray:
